title: Failure taxonomy & error dashboards for inference observability
creator: Evan Chen
description:
Background: We currently surface a single 'error rate' metric for inference routes which conflates transient client cancellations, overload, model decode failures, and upstream HTTP/gRPC errors. That makes incident response slow and masks regressions when model changes or kernel swaps introduce new failure modes.

Goal: Define a practical, actionable failure taxonomy for the inference stack (frontend, router, serving runtime, model execution) and ship a set of dashboards and tracing hooks that let SREs/ENG/PM: (1) quickly triage whether an increase in errors is due to timeouts, overload, model errors, transport codes, or downstream dependencies; (2) quantify tenant/customer impact by error type; (3) link a sampled trace and contextual logs for representative failing requests.

Out of scope: building new alerting on top of alerts produced by this work (will follow in ENG-4875).

Success criteria: taxonomy adopted by runtime, router, and API teams; dashboards in Grafana with drilldowns to traces/logs; new structured error fields emitted by services (error_type, error_subcode, origin_zone).
tasks: Draft failure taxonomy and map to existing error sources (client, network, router, runtime, model, GPU/oom, queue overload)
Define canonical metric names and label sets for Prometheus/OTel ingestion (see telemetry_schema)
Add structured error fields and tracing tags to: api-gateway, request-router, serving-runtime, model-proxy
Update log pipeline: parser rules, ECS mapping, and enrichment for tenant_id/model_version/route
Create Grafana dashboard with: error type breakdown, per-model P50/P95/P99 separated by error type, top tenants by error budget burn
Instrument sampled traces for failed requests and wire to Honeycomb/Jaeger with links from dashboard
Rollout plan: canary on staging -> dedicated capacity -> hosted with 10% sample -> 100% sample for failures only
Document taxonomy and dashboard runbook in Confluence
acceptance_criteria: Each service emits an 'error_type' field with one of the canonical values: timeout, overload, model_error, grpc_status, http_status, client_cancel, network_error, cache_miss
Grafana dashboard has panels for: error-rate-by-type, top-10-tenants-by-errors, per-model error-sli, error-latency-correlation, request-queue-depth vs error-rate
Dashboards link to at least one sampled trace and the raw structured log for a failing request
Unit/integration tests validate structured error emission for simulated failures
Schema and metric names published and approved in observability-docs
telemetry_schema: Log fields (structured JSON): timestamp, trace_id, span_id, tenant_id, route, model_version, shard_id, latency_ms, error_type, error_subcode, grpc_status, http_status, gpu_id, queue_depth
Tracing tags: error_type, model_version, request_priority, route_config_id
Sampling: sample 0.1% requests cluster-wide, 100% of requests with error or latency>5s
Retention: traces 30d full, logs 15d structured, metrics standard retention
dashboard_spec: Overview panel: error rate (5m) with stacked series by error_type and baseline comparison to previous 7d
SLO panel: error budget burn chart per-customer tier and per-route
Latency vs error type: heatmap of latency distribution filtered by error_type
Top failing endpoints: table with tenant_id, model_version, error_type, count, recent example trace link
Queue health: queue_depth over time, average processing_time, and queue-induced timeout rate
Transport codes: stacked bars for grpc_status and http_status with drilldown to raw logs
Model error details: frequency of failure modes from model (decode_error, memory_error, validation_error) grouped by model_version
tracing_changes: Add a standardized 'error_type' span attribute at the point of failure (router/runtime/model-proxy)
Capture 'queue_depth' and 'queue_enqueue_time_ms' as span attributes when request passes through request-queue
Create a short trace template for sampled failures that includes: gateway span, router fanout spans, runtime execution span, model decode span
Instrument span events for 'kv_cache_hit/miss' to correlate cache behavior with model error/latency
Ensure traces include model_version and shard_id for fast grouping in Honeycomb/Jaeger
pipeline_changes: Log parser: add rule to extract error_type and error_subcode from runtime JSON logs and map to ECS-like fields
Enrichment: attach tenant metadata (tier, org_name) from user-service to logs at ingestion time for dashboard grouping
Indexing: ensure error_type field is keyword and retained for 15d for quick queries
Add a small join job that enriches traces with the most recent rollout metadata (model_release_id) for up to 7d
Alerting hook: failed request examples should create a ticket link and attach a representative log/trace snapshot to Grafana
